articles.headline: COLLPLANT IS ACQUIRING LIGHTSOLVER- ENTERS SUPERCOMPUTING AND PHOTONIC COMPUTING MARKETS
sourceWarnings: El distribuidor original muestra 08:40 ET y Finviz 08:00. Se conserva la hora posterior del original; ambas son anteriores a la entrada. Adquisición anunciada, con cierre posterior.
articles.summary: CollPlant announced a definitive agreement to acquire LightSolver using equity and warrants tied partly to future milestones. Closing was expected subsequently; the signing was not completed integration.
